''[[Shōgun (2024 TV series)|Shōgun]]'' (5) | website = {{URL|www.actorawards.org}} | image2 = | image2size = | alt2 = | caption2 = | previous = [[30th Screen Actors Guild Awards|30th]] | main = [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]] | next = [[32nd Actor Awards|32nd]] }} The '''31st Annual Screen Actors Guild Awards''', honoring the best achievements in film and television performances for the year 2024, were presented on February 23, 2025, at the [[Shrine Auditorium and Expo Hall]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]]. For the second year in a row, the ceremony streamed live on [[Netflix]], starting at 8:00 p.m. [[Eastern Time Zone|EST]] / 5:00 p.m. [[Pacific Time Zone|PST]].{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/sag-awards-2025-date-1235875016/ |title=Screen Actors Guild Awards Set 2025 Date |last=Verhoeven |first=Beatrice |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=April 16, 2024 |access-date=January 8, 2025 |archive-date=December 27, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241227104646/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/sag-awards-2025-date-1235875016/ |url-status=live}}{{cite press release |url=https://www.sagawards.org/media/news/releases/outstanding-film-and-television-performances-honored-31st-annual-screen-actors |title=Film and Television Performances Honored at the 31st Annual Screen Actors Guild Awards |publisher=[[Actor Awards|Screen Actors Guild Awards]] |date=February 23, 2025 |access-date=February 25, 2025}}{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2025/film/news/sag-awards-winners-2025-1236313200/ |title=SAG Awards 2025 Full Winners List: 'Conclave', 'Only Murders in the Building', and 'Shōgun' Take Home Top Honors |last1=Moreau |first1=Jordan |last2=Lang |first2=Brent |last3=Earl |first3=William |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=February 23, 2025 |access-date=February 25, 2025}} Actress [[Kristen Bell]] hosted the ceremony for the second time since the [[24th Screen Actors Guild Awards|24th ceremony]] in 2018.{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2024/12/kristen-bell-sag-awards-host-2025-1236204766/ |title=Kristen Bell to Host 2025 SAG Awards |last=Hipes |first=Patrick |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=December 16, 2024 |access-date=January 8, 2025}} The nominations were originally scheduled to be announced live in-person on January 8, 2025, but were postponed due to a [[January 2025 Southern California wildfires|series of wildfires in Southern California]].
